label: TP
reason: User-supplied header name directly controls fileTarget via concatenation into a Java.io.File constructor, enabling path traversal attacks (e.g., '../etc/passwd'). The ESAPI encoder only mitigates HTML reflection in the response message, not the actual file system access. The path-injection rule correctly flags this as a critical flaw.

evidence.note: Header name flows to fileTarget constructor, bypassing all protections; path traversal possible
